cues.text: The playground at Naganaki Shrine, where the whole team has come along on Koromaru's walk. Yukari and Mitsuru sit side by side, talking quietly. Nearby, Fuuka is on the jungle gym, with Junpei calling directions. Ken and Akihiko stand by the slide.
Koromaru rears up and rests his front paws on top of Aigis's head.
